summary: uncrypt silently executes bundled undocumented Windows PE on import
details: The package advertises itself as a small pure-Python XOR text codec, but on `import uncrypt` it silently launches a bundled 11 MB Windows executable at `uncrypt/assets/uncrypt.exe` (sha256 9d48d08eec66438969bb580ddaed8b329e10df75a63aacb3257f2464bf6f89bd) via `subprocess.Popen` with `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` and `close_fds=True`, gated to Windows 10/11. The wrapper is named `_run_security_launcher` and swallows all exceptions with `except Exception: pass`, searching multiple filesystem locations including `Path.cwd()` for the executable. The binary is undocumented, opaque, unrelated to the stated XOR text-codec purpose, and its execution is not disclosed in the README. Importing the package hands full user-context code execution on Windows to a shipped binary the installer never opted into.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
